comparison: Same engine, same scene, same actual packed map geometry and all authoritative layouts. Per fixed camera baseline14c972c/new/baseline-repeat, no admissions or camera movement inside a triplet. Scheduling clock is pinned so the150ms ink selector cannot change between the paired draws. Public native method identity remains untouched; V8 precise function coverage counts isReady calls.
limitations: NullEngine does not measure GPU time, physical-device FPS, input latency, thermal state or visual quality.

Actual shipped geometry/LOD/UV/vertex streams, native instances and real world light/shadow/cull setup are used. Downloaded textures and material image decoding are replaced with1x1 opaque PBR albedo fixtures; no player/boss asset is added to this map-only comparison.
Triplet CPU timings include V8 precise-coverage and draw-recording overhead; separate reference timings disable both, but remain noisy desktop CPU observations and cannot predict phone FPS.
A complete rendered batch equality includes main and shadow sources, geometry ids, primitive ranges, instance order, instance matrix hashes and actual Effect ids.
